description: This file defines the ContainerInterface interface within the PSR.Container namespace, specifying methods for retrieving entries from a container and checking for their existence.

classes.name: ContainerInterface
classes.description: An interface for a container exposing methods to read its entries, including retrieving entries by ID and checking existence.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Finds an entry of the container by its identifier and returns it.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if the container can return an entry for the given identifier.
